description_en: Sets the credit limit for a reseller customer. This feature is available only for Resellers and Distributors
description_zh: 设置分销客户信控额度。此功能仅供针对Reseller和Distributor
name: SetCreditLine

Code.description_en:
The result code. Valid values:
200: OK.
1109: System error.
3040: The sub-account is frozen and the operation cannot be completed.
3041: The credit limit is not a number
Code.description_zh:
结果代码:
200 OK
1109 系统错误
3040 子账号冻结，无法完成操作 - 3041 信控并非数字

Message.description_en: The message that corresponds to the result code

RequestId.description_en: The request ID. A unique identifier that Alibaba Cloud generates for the request
RequestId.description_zh: 请求id，阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the API call is successful. Valid values: True and False. This does not indicate whether the subsequent business operation is successful
Success.description_zh: 候选值:True/False，代表了是否当前API调用本身是成功的。不代表后 续业务操作的成功
